title: Choose the Mars Bank visual world
question: Mars Bank should feel like the financial institution of a new world: credible, familiar to use, and unmistakably forward. Keep the proposed world, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Orbital Registry
options.lineage: spacecraft ephemerides, planetary survey charts, and precision civic registries
options.thesis: Mars Bank makes frontier finance legible as a trusted planetary coordinate system.
options.viewport: A vast plotted horizon crosses the homepage while live account coordinates and one decisive banking action lock to its grid.
options.risk: It can drift toward an aerospace contractor unless balances and banking actions remain the clearest signals.

options.label: Custody Ribbon
options.lineage: museum provenance ribbons translated into a financial ledger
options.thesis: Every token has a visible, continuous path through accounts, transfers, and time.
options.viewport: A single red custody line enters from the edge, folds through current balances, and ends at a clear transfer action.
options.risk: It identifies strongly with trust and traceability but less strongly with life on Mars.
options.case: Strong product clarity, but weaker new-world identification than Orbital Registry.

options.label: Struck Balance
options.lineage: cathode numeral stacks and bronze instrument gauze
options.thesis: Every possible value waits in the dark until the customer strikes one financial state into focus.
options.viewport: A monumental token balance burns through a fine gauze plane while account states remain as quiet ghost numerals behind it.
options.risk: Highly distinctive and frontier-ready, but dense instrument language could overpower everyday banking tasks.
options.case: Exceptional audience identification, with less immediate banking clarity than Orbital Registry.

options.label: Signal Mantle
options.lineage: living chromatophore skin used as an adaptive institutional signal
options.thesis: The bank changes its visual signal with financial context while keeping one stable body.
options.viewport: A calm pale banking surface carries one living field whose pigment expands around balances, alerts, and active actions.
options.risk: It fuses poorly with premium-bank expectations when the living texture becomes spectacle rather than information.
options.case: Memorable and adaptive, but weaker on product clarity and institutional trust.

canonCard.label: Premium banking, played straight
canonCard.thesis: A restrained institutional bank identity, executed at the craft level of the category leaders.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional split-image banking hero with a refined wordmark, clear proposition, and primary login action.
canonCard.risk: Credible and familiar, but unlikely to feel like the first financial institution of a new world.
